# Claw Code Harness - MiniMax Skill

![Rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/Rust-95.9%25-orange)
![Stars](https://img.shields.io/badge/Stars-173k-blue)
![Language](https://img.shields.io/badge/Language-Rust-red)

## Overview

**Claw Code** is the public Rust implementation of the `claw` CLI agent harness - a high-performance autonomous coding framework that enables AI agents to execute complex development tasks with minimal human intervention.

### What Makes It Special

- **173k GitHub Stars** - One of the most popular AI coding tools
- **Pure Rust Implementation** - ~20K lines of safe, performant Rust code
- **9 Modular Crates** - Flexible architecture for customization
- **Event-Driven Design** - Built for clawhip integration and automation
- **Multi-Agent Ready** - Supports parallel coding agents coordination

---

## Quick Start Guide

### Installation & Build

```bash
# Clone the repository
git clone https://github.com/ultraworkers/claw-code.git
cd claw-code

# Build the Rust workspace
cd rust
cargo build --workspace

# Run help command
./target/debug/claw --help
```

### Authentication

```bash
# Option 1: API Key
export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY="sk-ant-..."

# Option 2: OAuth Login
./target/debug/claw login
```

### Basic Usage

```bash
# Interactive REPL mode
./target/debug/claw

# One-shot prompt
./target/debug/claw prompt "summarize this repository"

# Shorthand mode
./target/debug/claw "explain src/main.rs"

# JSON output for automation
./target/debug/claw --output-format json prompt "status"
```

## Core Features

### Model Support

| Alias | Resolves To | Best For |
|-------|-------------|----------|
| `opus` | `claude-opus-4-6` | Complex reasoning, architecture |
| `sonnet` | `claude-sonnet-4-6` | Balanced performance |
| `haiku` | `claude-haiku-4-5-20251213` | Fast, lightweight tasks |

### Permission Modes

```bash
# Read-only access
./target/debug/claw --permission-mode read-only prompt "review code"

# Workspace write access
./target/debug/claw --permission-mode workspace-write prompt "update docs"

# Full access (default)
./target/debug/claw --permission-mode danger-full-access prompt "refactor"
```

### Built-in Tools

| Tool | Capability |
|------|------------|
| **Bash** | Execute shell commands |
| **ReadFile** | Read file contents |
| **WriteFile** | Create/modify files |
| **EditFile** | Precise text modifications |
| **GrepSearch** | Pattern-based file search |
| **GlobSearch** | Path-based file discovery |
| **WebSearch** | Internet research |
| **WebFetch** | URL content extraction |
| **Agent** | Sub-agent spawning |
| **TodoWrite** | Task tracking |
| **NotebookEdit** | Jupyter notebook manipulation |
| **Skill** | Skill invocation |

## Session Management

### Interactive Commands

```
/help      - Show available commands
/status    - Display current session state
/cost      - Show usage statistics
/config    - View/modify configuration
/session   - Session management
/model     - Switch AI model
/permissions - Permission controls
/export    - Export session data
/doctor    - Health check & diagnostics
```

### Session Persistence

```bash
# Resume latest session
./target/debug/claw --resume latest

# Resume specific session with command
./target/debug/claw --resume latest /status /diff
```

### Configuration File Resolution

Config loads in priority order (later overrides earlier):

1. `~/.claw.json`
2. `~/.config/claw/settings.json`
3. `/.claw.json`
4. `/.claw/settings.json`
5. `/.claw/settings.local.json`

---

## Workspace Architecture

```
rust/
├── Cargo.toml              # Workspace root
├── crates/
│   ├── api/               # Provider clients, SSE streaming, auth
│   ├── commands/          # Slash command registry
│   ├── compat-harness/    # TS manifest extraction
│   ├── mock-anthropic-service/  # Deterministic mock for testing
│   ├── plugins/           # Plugin management
│   ├── runtime/           # Core session, config, MCP
│   ├── rusty-claude-cli/ # Main CLI binary
│   ├── telemetry/         # Usage tracking
│   └── tools/            # Built-in tool implementations
└── scripts/
    └── run_mock_parity_harness.sh  # Testing harness
```

### Crate Responsibilities

| Crate | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| **api** | Anthropic/OpenAI API clients, streaming, request preflight |
| **commands** | Slash command parsing and help rendering |
| **runtime** | ConversationRuntime, session persistence, MCP client |
| **rusty-claude-cli** | REPL, CLI subcommands, tool call rendering |
| **tools** | Tool specs and execution (Bash, Read, Write, Edit, etc.) |
| **plugins** | Plugin lifecycle and management |
| **telemetry** | Session tracing and usage metrics |

## The Philosophy: Claw-First Development

### Human-AI Coordination Model

Claw Code implements a **three-part coordination system**:

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    HUMAN DIRECTION                          │
│         (Strategic decisions, goals, taste)                  │
└─────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
                          ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    CLAW EXECUTION                           │
│   ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐  ┌──────────┐    │
│   │ OmX     │  │ clawhip  │  │  OmO     │  │  Claw    │    │
│   │workflow │  │ events   │  │coordination│ │ runtime │    │
│   └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘  └──────────┘    │
└─────────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────────┘
                          │
                          ▼
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                   AUTONOMOUS DELIVERY                        │
│     (Code, tests, commits, PRs, notifications)              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### Key Components

| Component | Role | Link |
|-----------|------|------|
| **OmX (oh-my-codex)** | Workflow layer - turns directives into execution | [GitHub](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex) |
| **clawhip** | Event router - watches git, tmux, GitHub, agent lifecycle | [GitHub](https://github.com/Yeachan-Heo/clawhip) |
| **OmO (oh-my-openagent)** | Multi-agent coordination - planning, handoffs, verification | [GitHub](https://github.com/code-yeongyu/oh-my-openagent) |

## Use Cases

### 1. Autonomous Code Review
```
claw prompt "review this PR for bugs and security issues"
```

### 2. Automated Refactoring
```
claw --permission-mode danger-full-access prompt "refactor module to use async/await"
```

### 3. Documentation Generation
```
claw prompt "generate comprehensive documentation for the API"
```

### 4. Multi-Agent Parallel Development
```
# Spawn multiple specialized agents
claw /subagent architect "design the architecture for..."
claw /subagent executor "implement the database layer"
claw /subagent reviewer "validate the implementation"
```

### 5. CI/CD Integration
```bash
# Script-friendly JSON output
claw --output-format json status > status.json
claw --output-format json prompt "run tests" > results.json
```

## Troubleshooting

### Health Check
Always start with the doctor command:
```bash
./target/debug/claw
/doctor
```

### Common Issues

| Issue | Solution |
|-------|----------|
| Auth failure | Check `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` or run `claw login` |
| Permission denied | Use `--permission-mode` flag |
| Session stuck | Use `/new` or `--resume latest` |
| Build errors | Run `cargo build --workspace` in rust/ |

### Debug Mode

```bash
# Verbose output
RUST_LOG=debug ./target/debug/claw prompt "..."

# Show cost tracking
claw /cost
```
